content: The Risk Calculator ADA (American Diabetes Association) Comprehensive Risk Factor Assessment utilizes the American College of Cardiology ASCVD Risk Calculator, also known as the Risk Estimator Plus, to determine the 10-year probability of an initial atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) event. This tool is designed to assist healthcare providers in identifying individuals who are most likely to benefit from targeted interventions, such as statin therapy. Importantly, the calculator incorporates diabetes as a critical risk factor, recognizing that the presence of diabetes significantly elevates the likelihood of developing ASCVD.
